PullRequest.Title: editor: editor switching and breadcrumbs for untitled files, Markdown scratchpad
PullRequest.Body:
Untitled files are a quick way to jot something down, but today they are second-class for editor switching:

- **No breadcrumbs.** Breadcrumbs are hidden for every untitled file, even when its language provides symbols. (#84746)
- **"Reopen Editor With..." lists every registered editor** (Jupyter, hex views, profile visualizers, ...) because an untitled file has no file name that editor patterns could match.
- **No way back from a custom editor.** After reopening an untitled file in a text-based custom editor such as the Markdown Editor, "Reopen Editor With..." disappears, so the file cannot be switched back to the text editor. (#336052)

This PR makes editor switching work for untitled files, and uses it to turn a new file into a Markdown scratchpad in two clicks.

## What changes

- **Breadcrumbs for untitled files.** Untitled files show their symbol path (they have no file path). The breadcrumbs editor-type dropdown is available for them too.
- **Editors are matched through the file's language.** The editor resolver matches an untitled file without extension as if it had the first extension of its language, e.g. an untitled Markdown document matches `*.md`. The breadcrumbs dropdown, "Reopen Editor With..." and "Set Default" now all offer the same, relevant editors. This only affects which editors are offered; new files still open in the text editor.
- **Switching back from text-based custom editors.** "Reopen Editor With..." stays available for an untitled file in a custom editor as long as its text model still owns the content (e.g. the Markdown Editor). Custom editors that take over the content keep the existing restriction.
- **Markdown scratchpad.** The Markdown Editor is offered (priority `option`, never the default) for `*.txt`, which includes new plain-text files. Opening a new plain-text file in it switches the file's language to Markdown, so it gets Markdown breadcrumbs, Save As suggests `.md`, and switching back keeps highlighting.
- **No "no elements" placeholder.** The `showPlaceholder` breadcrumbs option was declared but never read. It now works and is turned off for the breadcrumbs in editor headers, so empty breadcrumbs (e.g. a new plain-text file) no longer show "no elements".

## Before / after

New untitled file → Reopen Editor With... → Markdown Editor → back to the Text Editor, recorded in Code OSS from `main` (5c11ec924d3) and from this branch.

**Before:** no breadcrumbs, the picker lists every registered editor, and after switching to the Markdown Editor there is no "Reopen Editor With..." to switch back.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7b5ebfff-811a-4ee5-8c71-61d4c77a3204

**After:** the editor-type dropdown offers Text Editor and Markdown Editor right away, the picker shows the same two editors, the Markdown Editor shows heading breadcrumbs, and switching back returns a Markdown document.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1e53b5a-7ab6-481e-8a56-f2c46bf64569

## Validation

- `npm run typecheck-client`: passed
- `npm run gulp compile-extensions` (includes `markdown-language-features`): passed
- `scripts\test.bat --grep EditorResolverService`: 34 passing (new: untitled resources match editors by their language's extension; Set Default writes `*.<ext>`)
- `scripts\test.bat --grep OpenWithEditorPicker`: 6 passing (new: untitled files are offered the editors matching their language instead of all editors)
- `scripts\test.bat --grep BreadcrumbsControl`: 25 passing (new: untitled files show their symbol path; no placeholder when `showPlaceholder` is false)
- `scripts\test.bat --grep BrowserEditorInput`: 12 passing
- `scripts\test.bat --grep EditorGroupsService`: 71 passing
- Manual: the recordings above, in fresh Code OSS profiles on Windows.

## Notes for reviewers

- With `showPlaceholder: false`, saved files with `breadcrumbs.filePath: off` and no symbols now show an empty breadcrumbs bar instead of "no elements".
- Saved `.txt` files also offer the Markdown Editor (as an option). Only untitled plain-text documents are converted to Markdown when opened in it.
- Untitled files in custom editors that take over the content (e.g. image preview) keep the existing "Reopen Editor With..." restriction; the data-loss issue around those transitions is tracked separately in #340054.

Fixes #84746
Fixes #336052

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The changed reachability, disabled-setting behavior, per-edit invalidation, debounce, and extension-host RPC are explicit. Only provider cost and setting prevalence are uncertain.
Findings.PerformanceResource: Document-symbol provider IPC calls and provider CPU work
Findings.PerformanceScaling: One request to every matching symbol provider on open, then another after each debounced edit that changes the model version, per visible active untitled editor.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Extra extension-host IPC and CPU pressure during opening and typing
Findings.PreviousBehavior: The file-provider guard rejected untitled resources, so they never constructed BreadcrumbsModel or scheduled document-symbol work.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: The guard now admits every untitled resource into the unconditional BreadcrumbsModel path, which creates and refreshes an outline even when breadcrumbs.symbolPath is off.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: RIGHT line 437 adds the Schemas.untitled exception that newly reaches the unconditional outline creation path.
Findings.Title: Skip outline work when symbol breadcrumbs are disabled
Findings.Impact: With breadcrumbs.symbolPath set to off, opening or editing a symbol-capable untitled document repeatedly computes symbols that cannot be displayed. Large buffers or expensive extension providers can add typing latency and extension-host load.
Findings.Evidence: The added condition admits untitled URIs. update() then constructs BreadcrumbsModel, whose _bindToEditor immediately calls createOutline. DocumentSymbolsOutline runs an initial request and debounces content-change requests by at least 350ms; OutlineModel.create invokes every ordered provider, and extension providers are forwarded through $provideDocumentSymbols. Yet BreadcrumbsModel.getElements returns before consuming the outline when symbolPath is off.
Findings.Recommendation: Keep the editor-type control visible, but only bind/create an untitled outline while breadcrumbs.symbolPath is enabled; react to setting changes by creating or disposing that outline.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open and edit an untitled document while breadcrumbs are enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: BreadcrumbsControl.update now admits untitled URIs, constructs BreadcrumbsModel, and waits asynchronously for the initial outline before symbols appear; editing continues without awaiting refreshes, but provider work competes for extension-host and CPU capacity.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Forward document-symbol requests to extension-host providers through $provideDocumentSymbols.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One call per matching extension-contributed provider on initial open and after each debounced content-change version, per visible active untitled editor; multiple consumers of the same model/version are coalesced by OutlineModelService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: BreadcrumbsControl rejected untitled resources before constructing BreadcrumbsModel, so this scenario made zero outline/provider calls.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Initial symbol breadcrumbs depend on completion; edit refreshes are off the direct keystroke critical path but consume shared extension-host/CPU capacity.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of visible active untitled editors, matching symbol providers, document size/provider complexity, and pauses between edit bursts; the 350ms-or-greater debounce coalesces rapid edits but each resulting model version misses the prior cache entry.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: At most one debounced refresh per DocumentSymbolsOutline, while different visible untitled models/groups can request concurrently; all ordered providers for one model are invoked concurrently via Promise.all.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: OutlineModelService uses an LRU of 15 entries and shares an in-flight/resolved result for the same model id, version, and provider set. Each content edit changes the version and creates a new request; cancellation removes the in-flight cache entry when the last consumer cancels.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed reachability, unconditional outline creation, per-edit debounce, versioned cache behavior, and extension-host RPC are explicit in code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Most users keep symbolPath enabled, where the work serves the feature. Provider cost varies widely; severity is medium because the disabled-symbol configuration makes the work provably unused but prevalence and milliseconds are not measured.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable when breadcrumbs.symbolPath is off: the PR newly schedules initial and repeated provider work for untitled resources although getElements cannot display symbols.

Scenarios.Scenario: Resolve editor types for untitled resources and refresh menus/context keys after model creation or language changes
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Initial editor activation synchronously computes matching editor ids; later model-added/language-changed events synchronously recompute ids and the breadcrumb editor-type control before event delivery returns.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Registered editor/glob count and number of editor groups whose active resource is untitled. URI equality filters nonmatching global model events before editor matching.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous on the UI thread, once for the matching active untitled group per model event; no spawned parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The flattened editor map is cached unless registrations change. Language-derived pattern resources are recomputed from in-memory model/language registries; there is no remote or filesystem lookup.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: all call sites and listener ownership were inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Work scales with registered editor patterns, but realistic group counts and language-change frequency are low and no expensive boundary is crossed.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: listeners are replaced/disposed with the active editor, filter by URI, and add only bounded in-memory matching on infrequent model events.

Scenarios.Scenario: Choose Markdown Editor for a new plaintext untitled scratchpad
Scenarios.CriticalPath: resolveCustomTextEditor awaits setTextDocumentLanguage before the existing Markdown webview resolution proceeds, so the language transition is on the explicit reopen action's critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Invoke vscode.languages.setTextDocumentLanguage from the extension host, causing the main-side text model language transition and related provider events.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly once when a plaintext untitled document is explicitly opened in the Markdown Editor; not repeated for already-Markdown documents or saved .txt files.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The Markdown editor was not offered for .txt and did not perform this language-transition call.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The custom editor waits for this single language change before creating/wiring its webview.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One explicit user selection per scratchpad; independent scratchpads can be opened separately, with no collection fan-out.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One awaited operation per selected editor; no burst or unbounded queue is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new cache is involved; the language guard prevents repeated transitions once the document is Markdown.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the guard and await are direct.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Language-change listeners/providers vary, but the operation is singular, intentional, and required for the scratchpad behavior.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: this is bounded, user-triggered work required to establish Markdown semantics before resolving the editor.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open Reopen Editor With, breadcrumbs editor-type dropdown, or Set Default for an untitled document
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Opening the menu synchronously derives an in-memory pattern resource from the current language, scans registered editor patterns, and builds actions. Set Default additionally writes the selected configuration after the user acts.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist editor association configuration when the user explicitly chooses Set Default.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One configuration update per explicit Set Default action, regardless of registered editor count.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Set Default already used the same configuration update path; the diff changes the association pattern selected for extensionless untitled resources.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Only the explicit persistence action depends on the configuration write; merely opening either picker performs no filesystem operation.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of registered editor glob entries; matching is grouped in one in-memory scan for the resource, not one boundary call per editor.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous single-resource matching; no parallel external calls.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Registered editors are flattened through the existing cached map. No positive/negative resource cache is added, and no cold network/filesystem lookup occurs while listing.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: resolver, picker, and Set Default call paths were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Extension installations affect scan size, but menu opening remains a bounded local operation and the changed language/extension lookups are constant-time registry/model accesses.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: the PR narrows untitled matches using local state and does not add boundary fan-out or repeated I/O.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render editor-header breadcrumbs with no breadcrumb elements
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The render update maps the current model elements and now clears the widget instead of allocating/rendering a placeholder item when showPlaceholder is false.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Current breadcrumb element count, typically path depth plus active symbol depth; the empty case is constant work.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous UI update with no asynchronous work beyond the separately analyzed outline path.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed branch is local and direct.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material for the empty placeholder branch.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: removing the placeholder slightly reduces allocation/rendering and introduces no layout loop or retained DOM.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all 15 changed files and traced untitled breadcrumbs, symbol outlines, editor matching, model-event listeners, custom-editor language switching, menus, configuration persistence, and placeholder rendering. Submitted one medium-confidence-in-impact/high-confidence-in-mechanism finding for unused repeated document-symbol IPC/CPU when symbol breadcrumbs are disabled; no concrete regression was established in the other changed paths.
